scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter api exec prisma studio
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate reset
